items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: They had a singer, Carmen Di Giovanni. He was there, a very fine operatic singer.

ctx.x: Oh, I wanted to ask you about the intermission at the, uh, the Suburban Gardens when you were there with Crumb. Did they have an intermission act?

Yeah, we had, uh, several acts down there at different times. There was, uh, there was, uh, several, they had an MC. They had a singer, Carmen Di Giovanni. He was there, a very fine operatic singer. Mm-hm. And, uh, a very fine, uh, he was a good, he was a good, uh, a good MC. And we had, uh, different dance, dance acts. Yeah. Different dance acts that were there. If I get my book, I can name it right, boom, Well, I'm just curious, uh, but, uh, it was nice, it was really, it was a nice job. It was really a nice job.
Do you remember Armstrong's, uh, State A?
